name: BookingsPlus
shortDescription: A UK service for letting rooms and venues. It handles enquiries, invoices, payments, hirer requirements and branded booking websites for one or more sites.
suitableContexts: Churches and charities hiring rooms, halls or facilities to the public
Multi-site churches or diocesan projects with several hireable spaces
Facilities teams needing booking, invoicing, payments and hirer compliance in one workflow

pricing.summary: BookingsPlus says it charges a flexible quarterly fee equal to 3% of annual booking value, with a one-off setup fee; it does not publish the current cap or a full worked example. It says lower setup fees are available for charities, primary schools and community centres. Request the current rate card, cap, minimum charge, setup fee, card-processing fees, VAT, support scope and termination terms in writing.

tiers.label: Flexible venue fee
tiers.price: 3% of annual booking value, charged quarterly
tiers.detail: Supplier's published approach. A one-off setup fee covers configuration, transfer of existing client and pricing data, website population and training; exact current amounts are by quote.

gdprInformation: BookingsPlus is supplied through Kajima Community/Kajima Partnerships Limited. A recent public booking privacy notice identifies Kajima Community as controller for bookings administered through the system and lists contact, booking, financial and limited compliance information that may be processed. The reviewed product material does not establish a church's specific controller-processor allocation, hosting region, sub-processors, retention schedule, payment-provider flow, access roles or export arrangements; obtain current contract documentation before launch.
integrations: Supplier describes payment-provider and accounting-system integrations; obtain the current supported-provider list, data flow and fees
importExport: Supplier says setup includes transfer of existing client data and room-hire prices
No public export specification was found; request client, booking, invoice, payment, compliance-document and report export examples before migration
support: Published setup includes a full day of training
Supplier describes phone and email helpdesk support and ongoing development

uk-operator.value: Supplier identifies BookingsPlus as part of Kajima Community and Kajima Partnerships Limited, with London, Northampton and Gateshead locations. The G-Cloud listing names Kajima Partnerships Limited as supplier.

venue-workflow.value: Supplier describes a cloud venue-lettings platform for online bookings, payments, invoices, dynamic pricing, booking workflows, reports, compliance documents and centralised multi-venue administration.

pricing.value: Supplier's public pricing page states a quarterly fee of 3% of annual booking value and a one-off setup fee, with lower setup fees for charities, primary schools and community centres.

privacy-context.value: A current BookingsPlus booking privacy notice identifies Kajima Community as controller and describes contact, booking, financial and limited compliance information it may process.

editorial.assessment: BookingsPlus is a broader UK venue-lettings service rather than church-specific software, but its end-to-end workflow is relevant to churches with substantial room-hire income or several facilities. It goes beyond a diary by joining public promotion, enquiry, bookings, payments, invoicing and hirer compliance. Its fee linked to booking value should be modelled carefully against a church's expected income, and its international parent-group context should be understood as part of normal supplier diligence.
bestFor: Church halls and charity venues with regular public lettings
Facilities teams that need online hire, invoicing and payment collection together
Organisations managing several sites or a centralised venue-hire service
strengths: UK operating context and identified supplier
Full venue-hire workflow including branded public site, payments and reporting
Supplier provides setup, data transfer and training
Hirer compliance-document workflow and configurable pricing described
limitations: General venue software rather than a church-management system
The 3%-of-bookings commercial model can become material at higher hire income; quote and cap require review
No public church-specific DPA, export specification or detailed sub-processor information found
Parent group is global even though the operating and supplier context is UK
Not a substitute for a church's own safeguarding, venue-safety, insurance or financial controls

procurementVerdict.problem: Managing public church-hall hire, payments and administration without fragmented booking records
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK-operated full lettings platform that combines a branded hire website, booking administration, finance workflow and hirer compliance
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Model the 3% fee, setup charge and payment costs against a year of actual hall income; then request the current contract, DPA, support scope, accounting integrations and exports before transferring booking and customer data
